data.title: Avicanna Transitions US Listing to OTCQB
data.description:
TORONTO, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Avicanna Inc. (“Avicanna” or “Company) OTCQB:AVCNF FSE:0NN a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development, manufacturing and commercialisation of plant-derived cannabinoid-based products announces that in the US, the Company will transition to OTCQB effective October 16, 2026.

About Avicanna:

Avicanna is an international biopharmaceutical company specializing in the commercialization of proprietary and evidence-based cannabinoid-based products for the global medical and pharmaceutical market segments. Avicanna has established scientific and medical affairs platforms that support its four commercial stage business pillars and have resulted in the commercialization of more than fifty finished products.

  • Medical Cannabis formulary (RHO Phyto™): The formulary offers a diverse range of proprietary products including oral, sublingual, topical, and transdermal deliveries with varying ratios of cannabinoids, supported by ongoing patient and medical community education. RHO Phyto™ is an established brand in Canada currently available nationwide across several channels and expanding into new international markets.
  • Medical cannabis care platform (MyMedi.ca): MyMedi.ca is a medical cannabis care platform formed with the aim to better serve medical cannabis patients’ needs and enhance the medical cannabis patients’ journey. MyMedi.ca is operated by Northern Green Canada Inc. and features a diverse portfolio of products and bilingual pharmacist-led patient support programs. MyMedi.ca also provides specialty services to distinct patient groups such as veterans and collaborates with public and private payers for adjudication and reimbursement. MyMedi.ca provides educational resources to the medical community to facilitate the incorporation of medical cannabis into health care regimens.
  • Pharmaceutical pipeline: Leveraging Avicanna’s scientific platform, vertical integration, and real-world evidence, Avicanna has developed a pipeline of proprietary, indication-specific cannabinoid-based candidates that are in various stages of clinical development. These cannabinoid-based candidates aim to address unmet needs in the areas of dermatology, chronic pain, and various neurological disorders.
  • Active pharmaceutical ingredients (Aureus Santa Marta™): Active pharmaceutical ingredients supplied by the Company’s majority owned subsidiary Santa Marta Golden Hemp SAS (“SMGH”) is a commercial-stage business dedicated to providing various forms of high-quality CBD, THC and CBG to the Company’s international partners for use in the development and production of food, cosmetics, medical, and pharmaceutical products. SMGH also forms part of the Company’s supply chain and is a source of reliable input products for its consumer retail, medical cannabis, and pharmaceutical products globally.

SOURCE Avicanna Inc.

Stay Connected

For more information about Avicanna, visit our website or contact Ivana Maric by email at ir@avicanna.com.

data.title: CME live cattle futuers rise to 10-week high on firm cash prices
data.description:
By Karl Plume

Chicago Mercantile Exchange live cattle futures climbed to a 10-week high on Friday on firm cash market prices and tightening beef supplies, while feeder cattle futures were steady to higher as feed corn prices fell.

Tight supplies of cattle continued to underpin futures, along with strong consumer demand for beef amid tightening supplies after the USDA last week cut its US production outlook for this year and next.

"We have a domestic supply shortfall that we're still facing," said Mike Zuzolo, president of Global Commodity Analytics.

CME December live cattle reached their highest level since August 7 and ended the day 1.100 cents higher at 228.350 cents per pound. November feeders peaked at a three-month high before settling 0.050 cent lower at 341.900 cents pound.

Limited cash cattle trades in the central and northern Plains this week were above last week's prices, while bids in the southern Plains were steady to higher than a week ago, traders said.

Wholesale cash beef values were mixed on Friday, holding within a recent tight range. The USDA said the choice boxed beef cutout fell $1.67 on Friday to $372.31 per hundredweight, while the select cutout rose 43 cents to $353.05 per cwt.

Beef packer margins narrowed on Friday but remained firmly in the black. The average margin dipped to an estimated $70.90 per head, down from $99.65 per head a day earlier and $72.55 per head a week ago, according to livestock marketing advisory service HedgersEdge.

CME hog futures rose for the second session in a row on Friday in a short-covering and technical-buying recovery after hitting contract lows earlier this week on slumping pork prices and weak cash hog values.

December lean hogs (LHZ26) ended 0.350 cent higher at 66.925 cents per pound.

The wholesale cash pork cutout value (PRK-MAN-CARCS) jumped $3.00 to finish the week at $80.55 per cwt, rebounding from the lowest level since April 2023 on Thursday, according to USDA data.

data.title: Cipher Digital Prices $850M 2032 Convertible Notes, Adds Capped Calls and Exchanges $165.9M 2030s
data.description:

The company issued $850 million of 0.00% senior unsecured convertible notes due 2032 with an initial conversion price of approximately $15.31 per share and granted initial purchasers a 13-day option to buy up to $150 million more. data.title: Klook Technology Limited Drops IPO Plans
data.description:
By Elias Schisgall

Klook Technology Limited is dropping its plans for an initial public offering.

The online travel company requested to withdraw its registration for an IPO, according to a Friday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

It had initially filed for an IPO of American depositary shares in July 2025.

Klook is the latest company to scrap plans to go public, as higher rates and yields, market volatility, and artificial-intelligence jitters put a damper on what was expected to be a hot fall for IPOs.

OpenAI, Oura, and Australian data-center companies Firmus Grid and Airtrunk are among the firms that have recently postponed IPO plans, according to The Wall Street Journal.

Write to Elias Schisgall at elias.schisgall@wsj.com

data.title: XCF Global Completes Business Combination with Southern Energy Renewables and DevvStream, Creating Vertically Integrated Alternative Energy Platform
data.description:
The combination brings together both today-and future technology alternative fuel production capability, biomass-to-fuels development and environmental-asset monetization to support domestic energy security, reduced carbon emissions and alternative uses for agricultural waste products.

  • With the closing of the business combination, XCF is updating its 2027 financial outlook to reflect gross product sales of $650 to 700 million, net revenue of $120- 130 million and EBITDA of $70-75 million.1
  • XCF believes that the combination will create meaningful shareholder value resulting from combined target 2030 annual gross product sales of more than $1.4 billion, net revenue of more than $400 million and EBITDA of more than $300m.

1 "Please refer to the important note regarding Non-GAAP Measures at the end of this press release for additional information regarding gross product sales. These targets are not projections and are forward-looking statements and are subject to the risks, uncertainties, and assumptions described under "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" below

HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / XCF Global Inc. ("XCF") , a U.S.-based producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel ("SAF"), today announced the completion of its previously announced all-stock business combination with Southern Energy Renewables Inc. ("Southern") and DevvStream Corp. ("DevvStream"). Southern and DevvStream are now wholly owned subsidiaries of XCF, which remains the publicly traded parent company. Following the closing of the transaction, former Southern and DevvStream equity holders hold approximately 20.0% and 10.43%, respectively, of XCF's outstanding common stock. In addition, Chad Langley, John Wharton and Carl Stanton joined the XCF board of directors in connection with the closing of the business combination, while Carter McCain stepped down as a director.

The combination creates a vertically integrated alternative energy platform combining both current and future technology pathways for renewable fuel production, biomass conversion and environmental-asset monetization. Southern complements XCF's HEFA-based New Rise Renewables technology pathway utilizing domestic agricultural waste product feedstocks, with a future gasification technology pathway affording the utilization of even lower cost feedstocks to provide a portfolio of today and future technological capabilities to the company. Additionally, DevvStream brings capabilities to manage and monetize carbon credits, renewable fuel incentives and other environmental attributes, which represent a strategic internal competency for XCF given the revenue generated for the company from these features of its products. The combined platform is designed to source waste and biomass feedstocks regionally, produce fuels near end markets and support local jobs while serving global demand. Its renewable diesel, SAF, renewable methanol and environmental-asset pathways are intended to support aviation, marine, industrial and other hard-to-abate industries using existing infrastructure where possible.

"Today marks an important milestone for XCF as we bring together renewable fuel production, new technology pathways and environmental-asset optimization capabilities on one vertically integrated platform," said Chris Cooper, Chief Executive Officer of XCF Global. "This combination expands our capabilities and supports our strategy to reduce emissions, enhance energy security and resilience, promote alternative uses for domestic agricultural resources, locate production closer to demand and pursue additional value across the alternative renewable fuels chain across our growing global markets. We're excited for this next chapter of growth and development for XCF as we build a leader in the alternative fuel sector."

About XCF Global, Inc.

XCF Global, Inc. is a U.S.-based producer of renewable diesel and SAF focused on decarbonizing transportation while supporting domestic fuel supply, energy security and alternative uses for agricultural waste products. Its New Rise Renewables Reno facility has permitted nameplate capacity of 38 - 40 million gallons per year. XCF trades on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol SAFX. To learn more, visit xcf.global.

Definitions for the non-GAAP measures are provided below. Gross product sales is a management estimate of the dollar value of the finished renewable fuel product sales in the end-customer markets. XCF believes that this is an important and relevant metric regarding the sales value of the company's products when comparing XCF to other companies. Management defines this as the number of gallons of renewable fuel sold by the Company during a period multiplied by the average observed or derived price in the end-customer market for each product during a period, including government incentives, feedstock, processing and logistics. data.title: Novavax shareholder Shah Capital to step back from activist role
data.description:
Shah Capital, one of Novavax's top shareholders, said on Friday it no longer seeks to influence control of the vaccine maker after restructuring into a family office.

  • The investor has filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission to voluntarily withdraw its registration as an investment adviser, it said in a regulatory filing

  • Himanshu Shah Family Office LLC has been established to manage the investments, the filing said‌

  • Himanshu Shah is the founder, president and chief investment officer of Shah Capital, Novavax's second-largest shareholder, according to LSEG data

  • Shah Capital reported beneficial ownership of 10.54 million Novavax shares, or about 6.39% of the company

  • The filing also disclosed that Shah Capital Fund LLC sold 2.87 million shares on October 5 at an average price of about $11.35 apiece

  • Himanshu Shah reported beneficial ownership of 10.66 million shares, representing about 6.46% of Novavax

data.title: SentinelOne Raises $1.25 Billion in 0% Convertible Notes, Adds Capped Call to Limit Dilution
data.description:

data.title: Mobix Labs outlines rare earths push; expects Q4 revenue near high end of $1.4–$1.8M guide
data.description:
Mobix Labs reported Q4 2026 revenue is tracking near the high end of its $1.4–$1.8 million guidance and announced expansion into rare earths via SPD and Winner Water moves.

Key Highlights:

  • Mobix Labs says Q4 2026 revenue will be near the high end of $1.4–$1.8M guidance, >100% QoQ growth and materially higher gross margins.
  • Mobix agreed to acquire Special Project Delivery (SPD); SPD has a definitive agreement to acquire Winner Water Services.
  • Winner builds a $25M funded rare earth extraction demonstration plant in Alabama to recover scandium and mixed rare earth oxides from coal ash.
  • Winner has received $53M in DoE/DoD awards over 10 years; demonstration plant permitting is complete with operations anticipated by Q1 2028.
  • Strategy aims to create a National Security Matters platform to onshore critical minerals supply chains and access public and federal capital.

data.title: DataMeds AI Secures Exclusive U.S. License to REBOOT AI Platform; Issues $2M in Stock
data.description:
DataMeds AI entered into an Intellectual Property License and Product and Services Agreement with REBOOT Health AI to power its GLP-1 weight management platform. The exclusive U.S. license, limited to the company’s B2C GLP-1 use case, includes reconfiguration of the REBOOT platform as the DataMeds Platform and a revenue-sharing arrangement. Consideration includes 666,667 restricted shares valued at $2.0 million with a 180-day true-up, plus $50,000 toward reconfiguration work (minimum estimated cost of $100,000). The license runs until the last licensed patent expires and restricts source code access and modifications.

Agreement details:

  • Agreement type: Exclusive U.S. intellectual property license and platform services with revenue share
  • Counterparty: REBOOT Health AI
  • Signed / Effective: Oct 13 2026 / Oct 13 2026
  • Duration / Termination: Perpetual until last licensed patent expires
  • Reason: Accelerate GLP-1 weight management platform with licensed AI technology

data.title: DataMeds AI Disclosed Failure to Satisfy a Continued Listing Rule or Standard
data.description:
On April 13, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failing to meet the $2.5 million stockholders' equity requirement under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). Since then, it converted payables to equity, completed other transactions, and believes it now exceeds the threshold, awaiting Nasdaq's formal confirmation. Nasdaq will continue to monitor compliance and may initiate delisting proceedings if future reports do not evidence compliance.
